script_text: Stop! Pisces, the stars are screaming at you right now. Mercury is squaring Neptune in your 10th House of Career, wrapping your professional dreams in foggy illusion while Saturn sits in your 2nd House of Money, asking you to anchor your worth in real value. This tense square tests your ruling planet Jupiter and your watery element with fear instead of faith. Your Moon in Cancer forms a soft trine to Neptune in your 7th House of Partnerships, so love feels deeply intuitive this hour, whether you're single or committed. If partnered, watch for emotional possessiveness disguised as devotion; if single, attract someone through private, soulful intimacy. In money, avoid sudden investments and build one steady income stream from your 2nd House foundation. An unexpected blessing may open a door you thought closed. Protect your 4th House home peace, too. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
